Build an interactive 2D figure from the brief below and the source image.

AUTHORED FIGURE BRIEF:
This figure consists of one large unit circle annotated with the standard special angles and the coordinates of their terminal points. A heavy black circle is centered on thin horizontal and vertical axes, and sixteen straight radii run from the center out to filled dots placed every 30 or 45 degrees around the circumference. Each dot carries an external label in two colors: the angle written in degrees and then in radians in red, followed by the point's (x, y) coordinates in black. Reading counterclockwise from the right, the labels begin 0 degrees, 0, (1, 0), with 360 degrees, 2pi, (1, 0) printed directly beneath it, then 30 degrees, pi/6, (sqrt(3)/2, 1/2); 45 degrees, pi/4, (sqrt(2)/2, sqrt(2)/2); 60 degrees, pi/3, (1/2, sqrt(3)/2); and 90 degrees, pi/2, (0, 1) at the top. The second quadrant continues with 120, 135, and 150 degrees and closes at 180 degrees, pi, (-1, 0); the third runs 210, 225, and 240 degrees to 270 degrees, 3pi/2, (0, -1); and the fourth returns through 300 and 315 degrees to 330 degrees, 11pi/6, (sqrt(3)/2, -1/2). The symmetric placement is the point of the layout, since the same three magnitudes 1/2, sqrt(2)/2, and sqrt(3)/2 recur in every quadrant with only their signs changing. Gathering all the major angles on one circle lets values outside the first quadrant be recovered by reflection rather than recomputed.

REQUESTED INTERACTIONS:
- Hover for each terminal point: the learner points at a dot on the circle, its degree measure, radian measure, and coordinate label brighten while symmetric points with the same reference angle are outlined, making the repeated magnitudes and quadrant sign changes clear.
- Click for component projections: the learner clicks an angle ray, horizontal and vertical projection segments drop to the axes and the coordinate pair is rebuilt as (cos theta, sin theta), connecting the unit-circle point to the two trigonometric values.
- Toggle between degree, radian, and coordinate label modes: the learner switches the visible label set, reducing clutter while showing that all three descriptions refer to the same fixed terminal points.

SOURCE FILE: OpenStax Precalculus 2e, chapter 5

There is no blueprint: decide the figure type, elements, labels, controls, and any step sequence yourself.

Display Labels
Hover any terminal point to see symmetric angles in other quadrants with the same reference angle highlighted.

Click any point to drop projections to the axes and show its components as (cos θ, sin θ).
// @FIGURE_CODE_BEGIN // [svgjs] const W = 900, H = 750; const CX = 450, CY = 375; const R = 220; const AXIS_EXT = 30; const LABEL_DIST = 60; const draw = SVG().addTo(document.getElementById('container')).size('100%', '100%').viewbox(0, 0, W, H); // 1. Data Definitions const A = [ { a: 0, r: "0", cx: "1", cy: "0" }, { a: 360, r: "2π", cx: "1", cy: "0" }, { a: 30, rn: "π", rd: "6", cxn: "√3", cxd: "2", cyn: "1", cyd: "2" }, { a: 45, rn: "π", rd: "4", cxn: "√2", cxd: "2", cyn: "√2", cyd: "2" }, { a: 60, rn: "π", rd: "3", cxn: "1", cxd: "2", cyn: "√3", cyd: "2" }, { a: 90, rn: "π", rd: "2", cx: "0", cy: "1" }, { a: 120, rn: "2π", rd: "3", cxs: "-", cxn: "1", cxd: "2", cyn: "√3", cyd: "2" }, { a: 135, rn: "3π", rd: "4", cxs: "-", cxn: "√2", cxd: "2", cyn: "√2", cyd: "2" }, { a: 150, rn: "5π", rd: "6", cxs: "-", cxn: "√3", cxd: "2", cyn: "1", cyd: "2" }, { a: 180, r: "π", cxs: "-", cx: "1", cy: "0" }, { a: 210, rn: "7π", rd: "6", cxs: "-", cxn: "√3", cxd: "2", cys: "-", cyn: "1", cyd: "2" }, { a: 225, rn: "5π", rd: "4", cxs: "-", cxn: "√2", cxd: "2", cys: "-", cyn: "√2", cyd: "2" }, { a: 240, rn: "4π", rd: "3", cxs: "-", cxn: "1", cxd: "2", cys: "-", cyn: "√3", cyd: "2" }, { a: 270, rn: "3π", rd: "2", cx: "0", cys: "-", cy: "1" }, { a: 300, rn: "5π", rd: "3", cxn: "1", cxd: "2", cys: "-", cyn: "√3", cyd: "2" }, { a: 315, rn: "7π", rd: "4", cxn: "√2", cxd: "2", cys: "-", cyn: "√2", cyd: "2" }, { a: 330, rn: "11π", rd: "6", cxn: "√3", cxd: "2", cys: "-", cyn: "1", cyd: "2" } ]; const refs = { 0:0, 360:0, 180:0, 30:30, 150:30, 210:30, 330:30, 45:45, 135:45, 225:45, 315:45, 60:60, 120:60, 240:60, 300:60, 90:90, 270:90 }; A.forEach(a => { a.ref = refs[a.a]; if (a.a === 90 || a.a === 270) a.align = 'center'; else if (a.a < 90 || a.a > 270 || a.a === 360) a.align = 'left'; else a.align = 'right'; a.yoff = 0; if (a.a === 0) a.yoff = -15; if (a.a === 360) a.yoff = 25; if (a.a === 90) a.yoff = -20; if (a.a === 270) a.yoff = 20; }); // 2. Helper Functions function fontStyle(s) { return { family: 'ui-serif, Georgia, Cambria, "Times New Roman", Times, serif', size: s }; } function buildItems(obj) { let items = []; // Degrees items.push({ text: obj.a + "°", color: '#c00000', tag: 'deg' }); items.push({ text: ",", color: '#c00000', tag: 'deg_comma' }); items.push({ text: " ", tag: 'deg_comma' }); // Radians if (obj.r) items.push({ text: obj.r, color: '#c00000', tag: 'rad' }); else items.push({ num: obj.rn, den: obj.rd, color: '#c00000', tag: 'rad' }); items.push({ text: ' ', tag: 'rad_space' }); // Coordinates items.push({ text: '(', tag: 'coord' }); if (obj.cx) { items.push({ text: (obj.cxs || '') + obj.cx, tag: 'coord' }); } else { if (obj.cxs) items.push({ text: '-', tag: 'coord' }); items.push({ num: obj.cxn, den: obj.cxd, tag: 'coord' }); } items.push({ text: ', ', tag: 'coord' }); if (obj.cy) { items.push({ text: (obj.cys || '') + obj.cy, tag: 'coord' }); } else { if (obj.cys) items.push({ text: '-', tag: 'coord' }); items.push({ num: obj.cyn, den: obj.cyd, tag: 'coord' }); } items.push({ text: ')', tag: 'coord' }); // Projection Coordinates (Alt) items.push({ text: `(cos ${obj.a}°, `, tag: 'altCoord', color: '#E91E63' }); items.push({ text: `sin ${obj.a}°)`, tag: 'altCoord', color: '#E91E63' }); return items; } function createMathText(parent, items, align, lx, ly) { let g = parent.group(); let els = []; for (let item of items) { let itemGroup = g.group(); let w = 0; if (item.num) { w = Math.max(item.num.length, item.den.length) * 9; if (item.num.includes('√') || item.num.includes('π')) w += 5; let c = item.color || '#000'; itemGroup.text(item.num).font({...fontStyle(16), anchor: 'middle'}).fill(c).x(w/2).cy(-11); itemGroup.text(item.den).font({...fontStyle(16), anchor: 'middle'}).fill(c).x(w/2).cy(11); itemGroup.line(0, 0, w, 0).stroke({width: 1.5, color: c}); w += 4; } else if (item.text) { let c = item.color || '#000'; itemGroup.text(item.text).font(fontStyle(18)).fill(c).cy(0); let chars = item.text.length; w = chars * 9.5; if (item.text === '(' || item.text === ')' || item.text === ',' || item.text === '-') w = 7; if (item.text === ', ') w = 9; if (item.text === ' ') w = 6; if (item.text === ' ') w = 12; if (item.text.includes('√')) w += 6; if (item.text.includes('cos') || item.text.includes('sin')) w = chars * 9; } els.push({ node: itemGroup, tag: item.tag, w: w, item: item }); } return { g, els, align, lx, ly, visibleTags: {}, layout: function() { let x = 0; let activeEls = this.els.filter(e => this.visibleTags[e.tag] !== false); for (let el of activeEls) { el.node.show(); el.node.x(x); x += el.w; } this.els.filter(e => this.visibleTags[e.tag] === false).forEach(e => e.node.hide()); let tx = this.lx; if (this.align === 'center') tx -= x / 2; if (this.align === 'right') tx -= x; this.g.transform({ translateX: tx, translateY: this.ly }); }, setTags: function(tags) { this.visibleTags = Object.assign({}, this.visibleTags, tags); this.layout(); } }; } // 3. Draw Background Axes and Circle const axesG = draw.group(); const arrow = draw.defs().marker(10, 10, function(add) { add.path('M 0 0 L 10 5 L 0 10 z').fill('#000'); }).ref(8, 5).size(10, 10); function axis(x1, y1, x2, y2) { axesG.line(x1, y1, x2, y2).stroke({width: 1.5, color: '#000'}).marker('end', arrow); } axis(CX, CY, CX + R + AXIS_EXT, CY); axis(CX, CY, CX - R - AXIS_EXT, CY); axis(CX, CY, CX, CY - R - AXIS_EXT); axis(CX, CY, CX, CY + R + AXIS_EXT); axesG.circle(R * 2).center(CX, CY).stroke({width: 2.5, color: '#000'}).fill('none'); // 4. Generate Interactive Geometry let anglesData = []; let outlines = []; const contentG = draw.group(); const hitG = draw.group(); A.forEach((a, i) => { let rad = a.a * Math.PI / 180; let px = CX + R * Math.cos(rad); let py = CY - R * Math.sin(rad); let dist = R + LABEL_DIST; let lx = CX + dist * Math.cos(rad); let ly = CY - dist * Math.sin(rad); if (a.a === 360) { lx = CX + dist; ly = CY; } ly += a.yoff; let ray = contentG.line(CX, CY, px, py).stroke({width: 1.2, color: '#000'}); let dot = contentG.circle(11).center(px, py).fill('#000'); let label = createMathText(contentG, buildItems(a), a.align, lx, ly); let outline = contentG.circle(20).center(px, py).stroke({width: 3, color: '#1976D2'}).fill('none').hide(); outlines.push(outline); anglesData.push({ a, px, py, ray, dot, label }); // Hit areas let hit = hitG.group().css('cursor', 'pointer'); hit.line(CX + 40*Math.cos(rad), CY - 40*Math.sin(rad), px, py).stroke({width: 20, color: 'transparent'}); hit.circle(40).center(px, py).fill('transparent'); hit.on('mouseover', () => setHover(a.ref, i)); hit.on('mouseout', () => setHover(null, null)); hit.on('click', () => setClick(i)); }); // 5. Dynamic State Projections & Tooltips let projX = contentG.line(0,0,0,0).stroke({width: 2, color: '#E91E63', dasharray: '6,4'}).hide(); let projY = contentG.line(0,0,0,0).stroke({width: 2, color: '#E91E63', dasharray: '6,4'}).hide(); let projTextX = contentG.text('').font({...fontStyle(16), anchor: 'middle'}).fill('#E91E63').hide(); let projTextY = contentG.text('').font(fontStyle(16)).fill('#E91E63').hide(); let state = { showDeg: true, showRad: true, showCoord: true, activeClick: null }; window.toggle_deg = function(on) { state.showDeg = on; updateCommas(); }; window.toggle_rad = function(on) { state.showRad = on; updateCommas(); }; window.toggle_coord = function(on) { state.showCoord = on; updateCommas(); }; function updateCommas() { anglesData.forEach((data, i) => { let isAlt = (state.activeClick === i); let showD = state.showDeg; let showR = state.showRad; let showC = state.showCoord || isAlt; data.label.setTags({ deg: showD, deg_comma: showD && (showR || showC), rad: showR, rad_space: showR && showC, coord: state.showCoord && !isAlt, altCoord: isAlt }); }); } function setHover(refAngle, index) { anglesData.forEach((data, i) => { if (refAngle !== null) { if (data.a.ref === refAngle) { data.label.g.opacity(1); data.ray.stroke({width: 2.5, color: '#1976D2'}); data.dot.fill('#1976D2'); outlines[i].show(); } else { data.label.g.opacity(0.15); data.ray.stroke({width: 1, color: '#e0e0e0'}); data.dot.fill('#e0e0e0'); outlines[i].hide(); } } else { data.label.g.opacity(1); data.ray.stroke({width: 1.2, color: '#000'}); data.dot.fill('#000'); outlines[i].hide(); } }); } function setClick(index) { if (state.activeClick === index) { state.activeClick = null; projX.hide(); projY.hide(); projTextX.hide(); projTextY.hide(); } else { state.activeClick = index; let data = anglesData[index]; projX.plot(data.px, data.py, data.px, CY).show(); projY.plot(data.px, data.py, CX, data.py).show(); let tx = data.px; let ty = CY + (data.py <= CY ? 20 : -20); projTextX.text(`cos(${data.a.a}°)`).font({anchor: 'middle'}).x(tx).cy(ty).show(); let tx2 = CX + (data.px < CX ? 12 : -12); projTextY.text(`sin(${data.a.a}°)`).font({anchor: (data.px < CX ? 'start' : 'end')}).x(tx2).cy(data.py).show(); } updateCommas(); } // 6. Init updateCommas(); window.__markRendered(); // @FIGURE_CODE_END
